The B matrix has stride_bn=3 (non-unit column stride), causing 9.5-way average shared memory bank conflicts that saturate the MIO pipeline (37.3% of stall cycles). With 160 registers/thread, only 3 blocks/SM fit -> 18.75% theoretical occupancy -> 0.49 eligible warps/scheduler -> compute pipelines idle 74% of cycles. On Hopper (H200), TMA descriptors offload address generation to dedicated hardware, enabling async bulk copies and freeing SM cycles. Simultaneously, reducing BLOCK_M from 128 to 64 cuts register pressure, allowing more blocks/SM and improving occupancy.
